1.w: For the music director, according to the al-tashcheth style; a prayer of David, written when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God. Have mercy on me. For in you I have taken shelter. In the shadow of your wings I take shelter until trouble passes.

2.w: I cry out for help to God Most High, to the God who vindicates me.

3.w: May he send help from heaven and deliver me from my enemies who hurl insults. (Selah) May God send his loyal love and faithfulness.

4.w: I am surrounded by lions; I lie down among those who want to devour me, men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

5.w: Rise up above the sky, O God. May your splendor cover the whole earth.

6.w: They have prepared a net to trap me; I am discouraged. They have dug a pit for me. They will fall into it. (Selah)

7.w: I am determined, O God. I am determined. I will sing and praise you.

8.w: Awake, my soul! Awake, O stringed instrument and harp! I will wake up at dawn.

9.w: I will give you thanks before the nations, O Lord. I will sing praises to you before foreigners.

10.w: For your loyal love extends beyond the sky, and your faithfulness reaches the clouds.

11.w: Rise up above the sky, O God. May your splendor cover the whole earth.
